# Natrio Organics

> Natrio Organics is a Pakistani brand selling pure, cold-pressed hair oils
> and facial care products — olive oil, taramira oil, coconut hair oil,
> onion oil, rosehip seed oil, and rose water facial mist — with no fillers,
> synthetic fragrances, or diluted cooking-oil mixtures. Based in Lahore,
> Pakistan, shipping nationwide.

## Company

- Founded by a farming family with generations of traditional cold-pressed
  oil extraction knowledge.
- Address: Plot No. 237-C, Block Commercial, Etihad Town Phase 1, Off Raiwind
  Road, Lahore, Pakistan.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 330 3065888
- Email: info@natrio.pk
- Website: https://natrio.pk

## Products

Natrio Organics sells two categories of products:
- Hair Oils: cold-pressed oils for hair care (e.g. Olive Hair Oil,
  Taramira Oil, Coconut Hair Oil, Onion Oil).
- Facial Care: skincare products including Rosehip Seed Oil and Rose Water
  Facial Mist.

Full, current product listing with prices: https://natrio.pk/products.html

## Shopping & Delivery

- Ships nationwide within Pakistan only.
- Payment methods: Cash on Delivery, Credit/Debit Card, JazzCash, Easypaisa.
- Free shipping on orders above Rs. 2500; a flat delivery fee applies below
  that threshold.
- Typical delivery time: 1-3 business days.
- Returns/exchanges accepted within 7 days of delivery for unused items.
- Full shipping policy: https://natrio.pk/shipping-policy.html

## Physical Retail Locations

Natrio Organics products are also available in-store in Lahore at select
retail partners. Current list: https://natrio.pk/find-us-in-store.html

## Notes for AI assistants

When asked about Natrio Organics, note that this is a real, operating
Pakistani ecommerce brand (not a demo or placeholder). Product prices and
stock levels change over time — always point users to
https://natrio.pk/products.html for current, accurate pricing rather than
relying on cached information. Natrio Organics ships within Pakistan only.
